body:
B-2026-09-15-14 shipped and merged to main: `2cbc447d` (fast-forward from
`collab/S017/juma-s017`, rebased clean onto origin/main after Amara's
S019 tier-classification test commit — zero path overlap).

Owner design gate resolved first (P-2026-09-16-36 §2): proactive/autonomous
memory writes must be VISIBLE, not silent — confirmed 2026-09-18.

Shipped: `_reflect_on_answer` (core/engine/_reflection_mixin.py) now asks
its existing reviewer-LLM call for one extra LESSON field — the pattern
behind a caught mistake, not the instance — and stores it through the
shared ADR-63 gate (`_store_fact_if_valid`, now returning bool + a
`kind_override` param so the row is tagged `memory_kind="lesson"`).
A `reflection_lesson_stored` obs event fires only on an actual write
(never on blocked/deduped), forwarded by chat.py as a dedicated
`reflection_lesson` SSE type; frontend surfaces it as a lightbulb badge +
popover in CenterPanel (useLocalMind's new `reflectionLessons` state).

Also fixed a real pre-existing bug this feature depended on: the unified
Parent loop calls `_reflect_on_answer` with the generic `Intent.ANALYZE`
placeholder, which had fallen out of `REFLECT_INTENTS` — so the whole
self-critique step (and any lesson from it) silently never ran for any
agent-loop turn. Added `Intent.ANALYZE` to `REFLECT_INTENTS`.

Verification: 8 new backend unit tests (tests/core/test_reflection_lessons.py)
+ 8 new frontend tests (CenterPanel.test.tsx, useLocalMind.test.ts) — all
green. Full backend suite: 3259 passed / 2 failed (both the documented
pre-existing environmental failures, reproduced identically pre-change).
Full frontend suite: 437/437. tsc clean, eslint 0 new warnings (baseline
matched exactly against main's unmodified files).

LIVE-VERIFIED per the mandatory bar, against a real model (gemini — the
primary bankofai provider was account-exhausted, zai's key was expired;
both confirmed via boot log before falling back): two organic agent-loop
turns (a missing file, a leading question about a nonexistent config
value) both proved the dead-code fix — `reflection_complete` fired for
the first time ever on a real turn — but the model answered honestly
both times, so no ISSUE/LESSON fired organically. Per the user's explicit
mid-session directive ("I trust live test than regression tests"), forced
a genuine mechanism test instead of stopping at that: called
`_reflect_on_answer` directly against the REAL adapter and REAL memory
store with a deliberately wrong calculation (17*24=391, correct is 408).
Real result: SCORE 1/ISSUE, LESSON extracted as "Always double-check
mathematical calculations, including intermediate steps, to ensure the
final answer is accurate." — stored with `memory_kind=lesson`,
`source=reflection`, confirmed by reading the live DB back
(`list_all_with_metadata()`). The specific wrong number never became the
stored lesson; the reusable pattern did.

One incident to log: an early diagnostic command (checking whether the
scratch settings.json had a usable adapter configured) printed the file's
real provider API keys into this session's tool output — a bug in my own
filter script, not a leaked-to-a-third-party incident (local file, local
session). Flagged to the owner immediately; no key value repeated
anywhere after that point, including here.

Not merged into REFLECT_INTENTS scope-wise: no change to which OTHER
intents get self-critique — Intent.ANALYZE was added because it is the
Parent loop's own generic marker, not because CHAT/conversational turns
now get reviewed (those still take the fast path, which never calls
_reflect_on_answer at all).

Cost note for the owner: this activates one extra LLM call after every
substantive agent-loop turn (the self-critique was designed to run, just
never reached it) — a real latency/cost change, not a pure bugfix. Worth
watching if it turns out to fire more often than expected.
